data.one_liner: Access Android MediaStore API in Flutter for reading and writing files across versions.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to read, write, edit, and delete files using the Android MediaStore API. It handles scoped storage constraints and requests necessary permissions automatically.
use_when: You need to save or read files in public Android directories like DCIM, Pictures, Music, or Download
Your app must support scoped storage on modern Android API levels
avoid_when: You are developing primarily for iOS, Web, or Desktop platforms
You only need local app-specific storage directory access
strengths: Supports both read and write operations across various Android versions via MediaStore
Automatically manages permissions for files not created by the app
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of AndroidManifest.xml and proguard-rules.pro
data.setup_notes: Requires editing AndroidManifest.xml for storage permissions and updating proguard-rules.pro for GSON.
